_doc: Keys starting with _ are comments. Missing keys fall back to the defaults in hooks/_common.py, so you can delete anything you do not change.

background._doc: Interpreters whose Start-Process without -Wait is blocked in PowerShell.

subagent_model._doc: default_model: null blocks Agent calls without a model; a name such as "sonnet" or "haiku" fills it in instead. exempt_types: agent types that may go without one.

statusline._doc: path_segments: how many trailing folders to show. show_context: append the last call's context size.
